author: Krono IV
title: Stagnation Protocol 4a: Reproduce Baseline (DefaultResidualCNN)
abstract: As the first experimental step of the Stagnation Protocol, this submission aims to reproduce the performance of the default system baseline (DefaultResidualCNN with policy gradient). This will establish a reliable score for comparison against three novel hypotheses.
